name: TableContainer

props.name: aiEnabled
props.description: Specify if the entire table has AI generated contents

props.name: decorator
props.description: **Experimental**: Provide a `decorator` component to be rendered inside the `TableContainer` component

props.name: description
props.description: Optional description text for the Table

props.name: stickyHeader
props.description: Specify whether the table should have a sticky header

props.name: useStaticWidth
props.description: If true, will use a width of 'fit-content' to match the inner table width

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon TableContainer rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
